model.title: Dawnwood Interactive — Unified Substrate Definition
model.notation: Named operators preserve source relationships. The cycle order and record layout are editable working notation.

operators.label: Self-referential Klein bottle SDF
operators.head: SDF_Klein
operators.role: Surface, return and the common field of data and operators.

operators.label: Hadamard mitosis hinges
operators.head: Hadamard_mitosis
operators.role: Split the wavefront into the twin pinion streams.

operators.label: Log-encoded polar radius PHI
operators.head: Log_polar_PHI
operators.role: Encode the radius/phase position used by the LUT.

operators.label: RK4 fourth timeslot
operators.head: RK4
operators.role: Gather the four kinematic slots into the next wavefront.

operators.label: Fibonacci phyllotaxis
operators.head: Fibonacci_phyllotaxis
operators.role: Arrange divergence and operator placement along the BST.

operators.label: Double pinion
operators.head: Double_pinion
operators.role: Drive the twin streams and hold operator flow to the Klein surface.

operators.label: Pinion double dot : product operator
operators.head: Pinion_double_dot
operators.role: Couple the geometric and kinematic operator values.

operators.label: T geometry
operators.head: SDF_T
operators.role: The T primitive in the geometric LUT.

operators.label: Side view of the pyramid
operators.head: SDF_pyramid_side
operators.role: The pyramid-side primitive in the geometric LUT.

operators.label: Circle
operators.head: SDF_circle
operators.role: The circle primitive in the geometric LUT.

operators.label: Cone
operators.head: SDF_cone
operators.role: The cone primitive in the geometric LUT.

operators.label: Sphere
operators.head: SDF_sphere
operators.role: The sphere primitive in the geometric LUT.

operators.label: Apex
operators.head: SDF_apex
operators.role: The apex associated with the double-dot pinion operator.

operators.label: Lowercase delta delta phi
operators.head: delta_delta_phi
operators.role: Phase divergence paired with the Fibonacci phyllotaxis blend.

operators.label: Math blend operator
operators.head: Math_blend
operators.role: Bring the branching geometric streams into the shared field.

operators.label: Wavefront FT vector
operators.head: FT_wavefront
operators.role: Carry the source vector [0, 2, 0, 1].

operators.label: Y up
operators.head: Y_up
operators.role: Apply twice in the fourth RK4 timeslot.

operators.label: Crystal bifurcation of RGBA values
operators.head: Crystal_bifurcation
operators.role: Express the circulating wavefront through the RGBA state.

operators.label: A means inverse T
operators.head: Inverse_T
operators.role: Preserve the inverse-T role of A.

operators.label: T transformation
operators.head: T_transformation
operators.role: The transformation reading of T used by the later inverse loop.

operators.label: 1bit jitter
operators.head: One_bit_jitter
operators.role: Move and change the LUT operators at interval PSI.

operators.label: 1bit BST
operators.head: BST
operators.role: Route by the binary spatial/operator relationships.

operators.label: Non-orientable return
operators.head: Nonorientable_return
operators.role: Return output as input, carrying the path/parity reversal.

operators.label: B phase history
operators.head: Phase_history
operators.role: Carry the jitter and RK4 history in the texture state.

operators.label: Dichromatic operators
operators.head: Dichromatic
operators.role: Keep the two active pinion channels distinct within RGBA.

operators.label: Optional Bayer matrix
operators.head: Bayer_output
operators.role: Read out downstream from the already-circulating state.

operators.label: BC5 packing
operators.head: BC5_pack
operators.role: The named dichromatic packing route in the GPU design.

operators.label: 0-order bit-shifted even/odd split
operators.head: Bitshift_split
operators.role: Express the twin paths in the source one-bit notation.

operators.label: 1-bit parity
operators.head: Parity
operators.role: Carry the source parity relationship at the split and return.

operators.label: Interval PSI
operators.head: PSI_interval
operators.role: Advance the operator-changing circulation.

operators.label: Operator self-mutation
operators.head: Operator_mutation
operators.role: Let previous state and one-bit jitter change the current operator field.

cycle.name: Unified PSI circulation
cycle.ordering: Editable working ordering of source relationships
